"""In-memory repository; imports deliberately demonstrate a cycle."""
from .models import Item
from .service import normalize_name

def fetch_all() -> list[Item]:
    """Return a sample inventory record."""
    return [Item(id=1, name="Field notebook", quantity=12)]

def persist(item: Item) -> Item:
    item.name = normalize_name(item.name)
    return item

Suggested remediation: Avoid dynamic evaluation. Use explicit parsing, a dispatch table, or a restricted data format.

```python
return eval(expression)
```

Source: atlas/security_examples.py:11 · Confidence: medium

Suggested remediation: Use parameterized queries for values. Allowlist identifiers that cannot be parameterized.
